content: WTO | Development - Aid for Trade WORLD TRADE ORGANIZATION Home | About WTO | News & events | Trade topics | WTO membership | Documents & resources | External relations Contact us | Site map | A-Z | Search Development - Aid-for-Trade Aid for Trade About Aid for Trade aims to help developing economies, including least developed countries, tackle trade-related obstacles, strengthen their capacity to trade, and build the infrastructure they need to integrate into the international trading system. It is part of Official Development Assistance (ODA). More on Aid for Trade News US$ 794 billion disbursed from 2006 to 2024 97 % of funding to improve infrastructure and productive capacity.
